claim_ceiling: Synthetic MITRE Synthea data only; local inference only; no clinical claim. Re-plots committed results; nothing new was run.

workstreams.name: Synthea cohort, form server, oracle
workstreams.note: 100 patients, splits 63/19/18, byte-reproducible. Two oracle rules still need PI sign-off (T02).

workstreams.name: B0 baseline (frozen rule filler)
workstreams.note: 33.3% full-form success (18/54) on the held-out test split.

workstreams.name: FCG harness L1-L3 + LOMO
workstreams.note: 0.333 -> 0.556 (12/0 discordant, p=0.00049). Discovery grade: modules written after B0 errors were seen (T01).

workstreams.name: Injected-error detectors M1-M3
workstreams.note: Preregistered: 654 forms, 702 injected errors. M3 source binding recall 0.99; LOMO: no single unique contribution.

workstreams.name: Admission-gate factorial (SYNFORM2-ERR)
workstreams.note: Per-field commitment leaf: detection 0.13 -> 1.00, 0 false admissions. Replication NOT_TESTED.

workstreams.name: Fault-injection factorial, 16 arms
workstreams.note: Seeded faults with known corrections; 100% repair is by design, not a model gain.

workstreams.name: OCR arms: Tesseract, Apple Vision/PDFKit
workstreams.note: Tesseract labels 0.967 / values 0.787. Apple A2 read-back loses dropdowns and long lists (p=0.5).

workstreams.name: VLM qwen2.5vl:3b boxes + injection
workstreams.note: Box recall 0.821, value read 0.736, 24 s/page. Injection followed 0/18 (V1i on open PR #29).

workstreams.name: Trained box validators (#14 #15 #16)
workstreams.note: No gain over deterministic contour control. D2 recall 0.956 / precision 0.656 is exploratory; no new-layout test.

workstreams.name: V2 YOLOv8n detector + OCR value check
workstreams.note: Pipeline merged; run in progress on MacBookPro (T09).

workstreams.name: Qwen text mappers on OCR lines
workstreams.note: Both Qwen mappers below the deterministic parser on identical input (209 and 109 vs 283 of 322 fields).

workstreams.name: Post-training arm M0 / M1 SFT / M2
workstreams.note: Qwen2.5-0.5B LoRA: one epoch-0 val loss (1.005), no adapter saved. Restart on MacBookPro.

workstreams.name: Custody: Merkle, Lean 4, red-team replay
workstreams.note: All roots recomputed independently; 7 custody weaknesses reproduced as tests; forged-custody fix (#8).

workstreams.name: CI, gitleaks, JSON-only publication gate
workstreams.note: Full-history gitleaks; 123 legacy files pinned by exact blob; new images under data/evidence/experiments rejected.

workstreams.name: Prompt-injection filter
workstreams.note: Measured (V1i, Tesseract reads the note in 19/57) but no filter exists.

workstreams.name: Noisy / scanned renders
workstreams.note: All arms read clean browser renders.

workstreams.name: Cost / latency per correct form
workstreams.note: Per-page latency recorded for some arms; no seconds-per-correct-form metric.

workstreams.name: Fresh replication cohort
workstreams.note: Needs a preregistered new Synthea seed scored once with frozen arms.

panels.title: Form filling: B0 plus harness modules (54 held-out test forms)
panels.note: L1 evidence abstain, L2 unit validation, L3 clinical filter. Only L1+L3 together move form success (+0.222, p=0.00049). Discovery grade.

panels.title: Injected-error detectors (preregistered: 654 forms, 702 errors)
panels.note: M1 Merkle breakpoint, M2 Lean 4 constraints, M3 source binding. Single-leaf edges are attributable; combinations are joint.

panels.title: Admission-gate factorial (SYNFORM2-ERR: 135 images, 945 field cells)
panels.note: Extractor qwen2.5vl:3b; challenger Apple Vision OCR. Commitment = salted per-field hash in the FCG leaf. Replication NOT_TESTED.

panels.title: Reading the form image (57 synthetic renders, 570 fields)
panels.note: Box precision for V1 = matched boxes / (matched + 213 false boxes). #14 and the contour control tie at 540/540 (gain 0). #15 RF F1 0.973 vs control 1.000.

panels.title: Local models vs deterministic code on identical input
panels.note: Empty cells are NOT RUN, never zero. The post-training arm is the main missing result (T08).

grades.evidence: Evidence grade: preregistered or independent run, synthetic data
grades.discovery: Discovery grade: designed after seeing the test data; needs replication
grades.exploratory: Exploratory: designed after a failure, same layouts
